pictures.name: QAH1-Noon-Sand
pictures.prompt: The valley of Mecca long ago at noon: blinding white sunlight, bare dark rocky hills, the sand pale and shimmering with heat, a few low mud-brick walls in the distance. Harsh, silent, enormous. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
